reason: B is the stronger, more testable proposal because it couples a defined refractory interlayer with explicit conductivity and durability thresholds and cites evidence for high-temperature and irradiation stability. Its thermal-conduction rationale remains speculative—electron transport dominates in these metals and disorder in an HEA may instead lower conductance—but A provides no supporting evidence and does not credibly justify silver’s mechanical or neutron-irradiation stability.
